description: This file defines actor enrichment strategies for different actor types in a booking audit system, including methods to get data requirements and enrich actor information, utilizing a strategy pattern.

classes.name: ActorEnrichmentResult
classes.description: Represents the result of enriching an actor with display information.

classes.name: Actor
classes.description: Type alias for actor object derived from BookingAuditWithActor.

classes.name: ActorStrategy
classes.description: Interface defining methods for actor data requirements and enrichment.

methods.name: getActorDataRequirements
methods.description: Retrieves data requirements for a given actor based on its type.

methods.name: enrichActor
methods.description: Enrichs actor information using the appropriate strategy based on actor type.
